title: Abafuna Iqiniso Abathobekile
intro: Ezweni lamandla asendulo nobuthakathi, kuvela ukungqubuzana okukhulu. Olunye uhlangothi lusebenzisa igunya lezibonakaliso zaphezulu, kanti olunye luzama ukulingana nokungenakwenzeka. Umphumela uzoshintsha umlando unomphela. Ungambula yini ukuthi bangobani labo ababone iqiniso eliphelele futhi bazithoba phambi kwalo?
clues: Sibone izibonakaliso ezidlulela ngale kwamaqhinga obuthakathi
Sonke sawa phansi, singakwazi ukuphika iqiniso
Saqaphela ukuthi lezi zibonakaliso zivela kuNkulunkulu Oyedwa Weqiniso
Sasingumphakathi wokuqala ukwamukela ukholo ngendlela ephawulekayo kangaka
Sathenjiswa ipharadesi njengenkokhelo yethu ngenxa yokholo lwethu
Izintambo zethu nezinduku zethu zaba yizinyoka phambi kwamehlo ethu, kodwa sakhetha ukuzithoba
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
